nodes.label: Pointwise Winner-Take-All Decision
nodes.rationale: Pointwise scores with a winner-take-all argmax must produce separability as a side effect of each expert's own score; the evidence says it does not, so the next variable is the decision structure, not representation or capacity.

nodes.rationale: Hypothesis: every stored prototype contributes to the loss of every old projection, so an old expert's evidence is reshaped by tasks it never saw and interference accumulates with expert count.

nodes.label: Owner-Only Gradient Cut Intervention
nodes.rationale: Cutting the non-owner evidence path to old projections raises Acc and C@3 with all other gradients bitwise unchanged; routing coverage recovers 80-86% of the gap to C0 while accuracy stays collapsed, separating the two endpoints.

nodes.label: Delta > Memory Existence Proof
nodes.rationale: At least one task family where per-fact weight edits beat retrieval at equal cost (image-conditioned recognition first, then behaviour/format and retrieval-missed paraphrases); on nonce facts memory-only matches, on counterfactual/parametric facts the weight edit wins.

nodes.rationale: The projection sits between the expert and the readout while the router scores the raw feature, so the candidate set cannot change and Delta C@3 is exactly zero by construction; the pre-registration expectation that coverage may move was mistaken.

nodes.rationale: CI uses CPU torch wheels because CI never uses a GPU and CUDA wheels are several GB.

nodes.rationale: Freezing the shared query collapses routing (-0.1507 C@3, -28.7 pp accuracy, 6/6 pairs) while the owner path stays invariant, so the address is not decomposable into independent frozen halves at this scale.

nodes.label: Stable Keys, Plastic Reader Invariant
nodes.rationale: The v2 invariant restated: stable keys + plastic reader + immutable consolidation + associative memory, not 'stable address'. Identifying side (W_j, E_j) consolidated and never re-aligned; reading side (query, readout) free to adapt.

nodes.label: ledger core (DeltaStore)
nodes.rationale: Per-fact LoRA deltas from a frozen base summed in id order; state_hash is a pure function of the delta set, giving bitwise G2 identity on revoke.

nodes.label: class-level routing decision
nodes.rationale: A task is a union of classes; the useful structure is at the class level, so mapping a class decision to its owner task recovers the routing ceiling.

nodes.label: continual ridge router
nodes.rationale: Class-level ridge sufficient statistics are additive, so a continual ridge can realise the offline class-level ceiling under the sequential constraint.

nodes.label: by_confusion consolidation policy
nodes.rationale: Part B measures only a hindsight, offline upper bound: it needs every task's features retained and a confusion matrix computed after all 100 classes were seen, so a positive P3 does not license it as a continual default.

nodes.rationale: Magnitude cliff: strong deltas learn but distort; canary KL penalty cut per-expert KLD ~12x while keeping recall.

nodes.rationale: TF-IDF and LLM last-token keys had inverted margins; a dedicated MiniLM encoder separated keys (tau 0.656).

nodes.rationale: The invariant every attempt kept: one independent score per expert, a competition, a single winner. Pointwise scoring must produce cross-expert separability as a side effect of each expert being individually good.

nodes.rationale: The expert-adapted representation makes each expert more accurate within its own task but less distinguishable from others: the routing constraint is cross-expert separability in the ranking space, not addressable by using the same evidence differently.

nodes.rationale: The expert bank buys isolation, not capacity: per-task isolation fixes the sequential-sharing collapse, while a shared adapter trained jointly is within one to four points of the closed-form readout.

nodes.label: Consistency-by-Construction (local estimates)
nodes.rationale: The prototype router's advantage is not a better metric but that the ranking is assembled from local incrementally registered estimates, so it stays consistent as the bank grows; a globally fitted classifier does not.

nodes.label: One-vs-Previous Protocol Defect
nodes.rationale: lock_historical_routing freezes earlier rows so each new row is optimised only against earlier tasks with no constraint against later tasks; the final argmax over all rows lets a later row capture an earlier task's features, and more training makes it monotonically worse.

nodes.label: Historical-Routing Lock (zero weight decay)
nodes.rationale: Adam's decoupled L2 term shrank locked rows; moving router parameters into a zero-decay group makes the lock exact, which by itself changes the pure recipe (76.60% -> 65.60%), recovered by distillation, stronger OOD and inference anchoring.

nodes.label: Analytic Readout (NCM / ridge / RanPAC)
nodes.rationale: Continual closed-form or training-free readouts over frozen features; ridge penalties pinned after task 0 to keep the readout order-invariant and exactly removable, deviating from RanPAC's per-task re-selection.

nodes.label: Closed-Form Ridge Readout
nodes.rationale: A zero-parameter accumulated sufficient-statistics readout dominates every learned rung, so the expert bank must justify itself against it.

nodes.rationale: Keys are never trained: the frozen content-hashed backbone emits the address and ExactCosineIndex retrieves; fixed prototype retrieval is TOST-equivalent to the learned address with zero router parameters.

nodes.label: Three Time Scales (fast / medium / slow)
nodes.rationale: Fast = one-item append-only memory; medium = closed-form linear edit; slow = trained frozen experts; three different cost and reversibility profiles rather than one mechanism.

nodes.label: ACID Guarantee Set (G1-G5)
nodes.rationale: G1 atomic, G2 reversible (pre-promote hash), G3 isolated (interference budget + router canary), G4 durable cross-session hash, G5 auditable provenance; a metaphor for the guarantee set, not DB-ACID.

nodes.label: Router-Integrity Invariant (G3)
nodes.rationale: The router is treated as an invariant with a canary set so locality and abstention stay measurable; without it revoke is a router trick (the SEUF/GRIP failure mode).

nodes.label: State-Identity Revocation (G2)
nodes.rationale: revoke(id) restores the pre-promote state hash, bitwise on the arithmetic path; hash identity is bookkeeping, so the load-bearing measurement is behavioural return (canary KL, retain accuracy).

nodes.label: Transaction Ledger
nodes.rationale: Append-only ledger {id, kind, provenance, hash, parent state}; state = H(H0, L) so every write is auditable and any can be revoked back to the pre-promote hash. The system property, not a new block, is the contribution.

nodes.rationale: The feasibility objection to E2 was withdrawn: E2 non-execution stands on scientific ground (no usable confirmatory operating point), not on cost.

nodes.label: L_evidence loss
nodes.rationale: Never computed through the shared readout g, and always a mean, never a sum, so its absolute weight does not grow with task count.

nodes.label: detach gradient cut
nodes.rationale: detach preserves forward values (loss bitwise unchanged) and removes exactly the non-owner gradient path into old projections W_j.

nodes.label: fwt (forward transfer) definition
nodes.rationale: Measured at the representation level (closed-form ridge probe on current vs raw frozen features) because the obvious 'evaluate before training' version is structurally zero in growing-head class-incremental settings.

nodes.label: metric blocks (conformance)
nodes.rationale: Blocks not levels: a level forces a total order and made 81 legacy pre-byte-accounting runs unrepresentable, whereas blocks let them stay usable outside Pareto studies.

nodes.label: Router Ranking Study pre-registration
nodes.rationale: A new router is a new hypothesis, so it belongs to a new pre-registration rather than Stage 1; primary endpoint is Delta C@3 (coverage, not accuracy).

nodes.label: S11 confirmatory stage
nodes.rationale: Six seeds chosen arithmetically because N=5 cannot reach p<0.05 under the exact two-sided sign test while N=6 can (0.0312).

nodes.label: PAL-MoE Architecture Contract (S1)
nodes.rationale: S1 changes no behaviour: it replaces the fused v1 abstraction with four interfaces so capacity, readout and routing experiments can be run separately.

nodes.label: PAL-MoE Measurement Contract (S0)
nodes.rationale: Every experiment must emit a model-independent record whose fields were decided before the experiment ran, so no metric is added after the fact.

nodes.label: Stage 1 Results
nodes.rationale: Two rules govern every experiment: one variable changes at a time, and a failing rung is reported, not tuned.

nodes.label: AC1: address-freeze completion
nodes.rationale: The smallest test that can falsify the completeness of C0, and the gate for AC2 (plastic values): an address that is the pair (P, W_j) cannot be stable while P is plastic.

nodes.label: AC3: address-space ablation
nodes.rationale: In E2 the address and the value are the same object (h_j = W_j E_j(z)); whether the readout can decode what a fixed-space ranking picks is the unmeasured question.

nodes.label: Coupling ablation: accumulated evidence re-alignment
nodes.rationale: Feasibility is a first-class constraint: a development smoke decides execution, and the protocol is never sped up inside the study.

nodes.label: E2: evidence-producing experts
nodes.rationale: First study in the chain where the router reads information the expert itself produced, making cross-expert evidence comparability an explicit target.

nodes.label: Feature Cache Protocol
nodes.rationale: Precompute frozen-encoder features and run the whole pipeline on them, so replay baselines store feature vectors rather than raw images and the hybrid's raw store is disabled; the byte comparison needs the raw pipeline.

nodes.label: Frozen Baseline eval() Fix (BatchNorm drift)
nodes.rationale: A frozen encoder must stay in eval() everywhere; the earlier table trained baselines with model.train(), flipping the frozen conv BatchNorm back to training and badly understating replay baselines. The corrected margin over the best baseline is ~2.7 points, not ~14.

nodes.label: OOD Negative-Boundary Loss
nodes.rationale: Max-entropy on historical prototypes for the newest expert lifts pure zero-replay accuracy from 49.85% to 76.60%; the new expert learns the boundary of its own task and stays agnostic about old tasks.

nodes.label: Prototype-Anchored Inference Routing
nodes.rationale: At inference an input close to a stored prototype inherits that prototype's historical routing distribution; confidence is threshold-free (1 - d1/d2) because absolute distances are not comparable across feature spaces.

nodes.label: Recency Funnel
nodes.rationale: Without the OOD term each new expert's routing row captured every task's routing after joint calibration; old experts starved and old-task accuracy collapsed. On CIFAR the funnel is representation drift, not router weakness.

nodes.label: Router-Anchor Distillation
nodes.rationale: Training the router to predict explicit prototype owners is a supervised signal derived entirely from stored latents and task ids with no raw exemplars; it lifts the raw router from 21.3% to 38.0% and is the dominant stability mechanism.

nodes.label: Strong Frozen Backbone as Biggest Lever
nodes.norm_label: strong frozen backbone as biggest lever
nodes.rationale: Swapping the frozen SimCLR conv encoder for a frozen ImageNet ResNet-18 roughly doubles the 20-task CIFAR-100 result; the conv representation, not the router or validation gate, was the long-horizon bottleneck.

nodes.label: Negative-Boundary Regularization (not OOD detection)
nodes.rationale: Naming note: the negative-boundary term is not classical OOD detection; the correct expression is a regularisation over historical latent regions, wanting the new expert to produce high-entropy predictions there.

nodes.label: Uniform Top-3 Aggregation
nodes.rationale: No learned selector, temperature or weighting; uniform average chosen so the only difference from WTA is the decision rule, with full-class unmasked posteriors so the WTA arm reproduces the ladder anchor exactly.

nodes.label: Evidence-Producing Experts (E2)
nodes.rationale: The single-expert evidence pathway is valid but the continual multi-expert formulation collapses at 20 experts; the confirmatory run stopped on a failed operating point veto, not on cost.

nodes.label: E1 Shared Decision Space
nodes.rationale: Every expert's adapted feature is projected by one shared affine P (identity-initialised) and read by one shared g, so two experts' outputs are compared as points in one space; E0 is recovered at step 0.

nodes.label: Novelty Claim (combination under equal-byte)
nodes.rationale: Not a MoE for CL - that space is occupied; the defensible combination is memory-constrained class-incremental learning with dynamically allocated experts, compact latent replay and prototype-anchored routing, proven byte-for-byte.

nodes.norm_label: v2 core losses l_task + l_gate + l_func

nodes.label: Counterfactual Reuse-vs-Expand Probe
nodes.rationale: A greedy one-step lookahead under a stochastic probe, with mandatory compute parity including the gate fit; honestly framed as not a causal counterfactual estimate, and its value is measured by the E2 allocation ablation.

nodes.label: Expansion Safety (top-1 preservation)
nodes.rationale: The safety criterion is argmax preservation, not mass bound: old argmax survives iff a < m/(1+m); the bias is calibrated to min(eps0, t*) over protected anchors so raising eps0 can never silently break top-1.

nodes.label: Function-Space Merge
nodes.rationale: Weight-space proximity is not function-space proximity and f((t1+t2)/2) != (f(t1)+f(t2))/2; candidate selection uses adapter cosine and output KL, the target is the responsibility-weighted mixture, and commits only if the anchor metrics do not regress.

nodes.label: Nested Residual Gate Product
nodes.rationale: Routing is a stack of scalar sigmoid gates rather than a shared softmax, removing the shared denominator so expansion cannot perturb history; the newest gate is outermost, which is also the recency-funnel risk controlled by the candidate filter, L_gate and L_func.
